continuous.description: Rotary axes only: turns without limit, so min and max are not enforced.
continuous.title: Continuous

home.description: Position after homing. May lie outside the soft limits: the firmware homes against a switch that moves can then not return to.
home.title: Home

max.description: Soft limit. Ignored for continuous axes.
max.title: Max

min.description: Soft limit. Ignored for continuous axes.
min.title: Min

field_of_view.description: Width (x) and height (y) of the view in mm.

position.description: Head cameras: offset from the head. Fixed cameras: machine coordinates.

settle_s.description: Wait this long after a move before using a frame (vibration, latency).
settle_s.title: Settle S

error.description: Why the camera is not delivering frames, if so.
error.title: Error

streaming.description: Frames are being captured for at least one viewer.
streaming.title: Streaming

width.description: Native frame width, when the camera is on.
width.title: Width

address.description: Network address the client connected from.
address.title: Address

name.description: Name the client gave when connecting, such as 'Studio'.
name.title: Name

ClientMessage.description: Heartbeat. Clients send one every couple of seconds; the server answers with pong.
ClientMessage.title: PingMessage

FeederBank.description: A row of evenly spaced feeder slots, such as one LumenPnP feeder rail.

first_pick.description: Pick location of the first slot.

length.description: Feeder length along the tape, in mm.
length.title: Length

pitch.description: Step from one slot's pick location to the next.

rotation.description: Tape direction in degrees; 90 means parts feed toward +Y.
rotation.title: Rotation

width.description: Feeder width across the tape, in mm.
width.title: Width

FeederBank.title: FeederBank

axis.description: Home sensors: the axis they home.
axis.title: Axis

threshold.description: Vacuum inputs: readings at or past this value, going toward range.max, mean a part is held.
threshold.title: Threshold

distance.description: Relative distance, mm or degrees. Clamped to limits.
distance.title: Distance

force.description: Take the lease even if another client holds it. Ask the user first.
force.title: Force

holder.description: The client allowed to move the machine, or null if no one holds it.

diameter.description: Fiducials: the round mark's diameter in mm.
diameter.title: Diameter

style.description: How the simulator draws a fiducial: a plain dot, or the LumenPnP datum board (a 1 mm copper dot in a reticle, with rings, a 5 mm grid, and corner fiducials).
style.title: Style

bed.description: Outline of the machine bed, for drawing.

provisional.description: Dimensions are estimates that have not been measured on a real machine.
provisional.title: Provisional

safe_z.description: A nozzle at or above this height (on its own Z scale) is safe for travel.
safe_z.title: Safe Z

safe_z_input.description: A digital input that reads true when every nozzle is at safe height.
safe_z_input.title: Safe Z Input

visual_homing.description: After homing, center the top camera on the homing fiducial and correct the X/Y coordinates to its known position.
visual_homing.title: Visual Homing

busy.description: A motion operation is in progress.
busy.title: Busy

connection_error.description: Why the last attempt to connect to the machine failed, if it did.
connection_error.title: Connection Error

estop.description: An emergency stop is latched; reset before moving.
estop.title: Estop

firmware.description: Firmware name and version, when known.
firmware.title: Firmware

inputs.description: Reading per profile input: bool for digital, number for analog.
inputs.title: Inputs

motion_enabled.description: Motion commands are currently allowed (connected, client present, no E-stop).
motion_enabled.title: Motion Enabled

position.description: Current position per axis, mm or degrees.
position.title: Position

speed_scale.description: Moves run at no more than this fraction of full speed (bring-up mode).
speed_scale.title: Speed Scale

warnings.description: Problems worth showing the operator, such as a firmware mismatch.
warnings.title: Warnings

z_safe.description: Every nozzle is at safe travel height. From the safe-Z input when the profile has one, otherwise computed from the Z position.
z_safe.title: Z Safe

pattern.description: Regular expression with a 'value' group, matched against the reply.
pattern.title: Pattern

read.description: Commands to send; the value is in the last one's reply.
read.title: Read

sign_bits.description: Treat the raw value as a two's-complement number of this many bits.
sign_bits.title: Sign Bits

clear_sign_bits.description: Remove the base input's sign_bits instead of setting it.
clear_sign_bits.title: Clear Sign Bits

connect.description: Sent after the firmware answers M115.
connect.title: Connect

expected_machine_type.description: MACHINE_TYPE that M115 should report; others get a warning.
expected_machine_type.title: Expected Machine Type

stop.description: Quick stop: end motion, stay running.
stop.title: Stop

position.description: Target per axis. Axes left out do not move.
position.title: Position

speed.description: Speed limit in units per second. Defaults to axis max.
speed.title: Speed

offset.description: Position relative to the head (top camera center).

z_sign.description: Direction of this nozzle on its Z axis. Two nozzles sharing one Z motor move in opposite directions: one has 1, the other -1.
z_sign.title: Z Sign

message.description: What the operation found or did, for people.
message.title: Message

PresenceLostEvent.description: No client has been connected for the grace period. Running jobs pause.
PresenceLostEvent.title: PresenceLostEvent

clients.description: Clients with a live event-socket connection.
clients.title: Clients

ValueRange.description:
A display range. ``max`` may be below ``min`` for readings that grow more negative,
such as raw vacuum sensor counts.
ValueRange.title: ValueRange
